data.title: Energy Corps Names Four New Grantees Advancing the Shift from Energy Poverty to Energy Prosperity
data.description: Four new grantees have been announced by Energy Corps today in Pittsburgh on September 18, 2026. These projects aim to enhance access to cost-effective, dependable, and contemporary energy for various communities across East and West Africa, as well as Tribal Nations in the United States. Energy Corps, a nonprofit organization based in the U.S., is facilitating these initiatives.
